source.title: Dataset for: Long-term assessment of beef cattle performance and hair cortisol accumulation in a silvopastoral system

population.classification: growing Maremmana heifers and steers; not mature cows

source.attribution: Ripamonti, A. et al. (2025). Beef cattle performance and hair cortisol accumulation in silvopastoral and pastoral systems: a 2-year assessment. Animal 19(3), 101425. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.animal.2025.101425. Dataset DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.12568499.

reportedAdgReconciliation.interpretation: Evaluation target is recomputed from consecutive observed weights and actual elapsed dates. Reported ADG is retained in the source archive but not substituted for inconsistent endpoints.

evaluation.engineInputs: Observed start weight and interval duration only; default pasture state/configuration. Observed supplementation, forage quality, pasture mass, weather and system are not supplied to the engine.

metricSamplingUncertainty.method: Paired percentile cluster bootstrap; resample unique animals with replacement and retain every observed interval and grazing system recorded for each selected animal.
metricSamplingUncertainty.unit: animal; intervals remain grouped within the animal
metricSamplingUncertainty.pairedComparison: Engine and baseline errors are computed on the same resampled animal intervals in each replicate.
metricSamplingUncertainty.interpretation: These intervals quantify sampling uncertainty of error metrics for this 2022 cohort conditional on this one study/site. They are not prediction intervals, do not estimate year/site transport uncertainty, and do not calibrate the product.

evaluation.interpretation: Repeated intervals are clustered within animal; the paired animal-cluster bootstrap quantifies local sampling uncertainty for error metrics, not prediction-interval coverage. This tests one ADG component and is not calibration, causal inference, full engine validation, or validation of DMI, forage stock, cost, or the pasture-versus-confinement comparison.

limits: One Italian Maremmana farm and two annual cohorts do not represent Brazilian Bos indicus farms or all grazing systems.
The paper reports initial group mean ages of 314–331 days; the cohort is growing heifers and steers, not mature cows.
The 2022 cohort is a year holdout with no animal identities shared with 2021, but the cohorts come from the same study and site.
The paper reports supplements and group-level forage/intake context, but this engine diagnostic does not map those observations to inputs.
The article does not define this dataset as the approved primary USDA/CPER case; keep it as an independent exploratory ADG check.
A reported ADG value is not used when it disagrees with its adjacent measured weight endpoints and elapsed dates.
